difficulty_rationale: Naive route is 37×43 as two-digit long multiplication (37×40 + 37×3 = 1480 + 111), which is doable but usually blows past 20 s for an average adult without paper. The insight — spotting that both operands are 3 away from 40 — turns it into (40−3)(40+3) = 1600 − 9, one subtraction after one recognition step. The difference-of-squares identity is standard school algebra, so the insight is findable in the moment rather than recalled from a table.
